content: TTL-based reservation holds have two known failure modes: (1) expiry only marks a hold logically dead but something must still reclaim the capacity slot -- if reclamation is deferred/lazy, expired-but-unreclaimed holds keep counting against capacity; (2) a confirm request racing exactly at TTL boundary can race the lazy-reclaim path, requiring the confirm operation to atomically verify the hold is still valid (not expired) as part of the same transaction that converts it to a booking.
